docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
Flint is currently available only for Linux.

Prerequisits: - GCC/Clang compiler chain - GIT

Run the following command in terminal:

curl -fsSL -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" https://api.github.com/repos/mainak55512/flint/contents/build.sh | bash

flint is invoked as:

flint <command> [args]

Running flint with no command prints a short usage summary and exits with status 1.

docs.title: init
docs.text:
Initialize a new flint project in the current directory.

flint init

docs.title: add <url>@<version>
docs.text:
Add a remote library dependency by URL.

flint add <url>@<version>
Note: version is the tag name of the remote repository. To install the latest version of the library use @unknown. The remote repository must contain composition.json.

e.g. flint add https://github.com/mainak55512/arena@v0.1.1 or, flint add https://github.com/mainak55512/arena@unknown

Arguments

Argument Description url The URL of the library to add as a dependency

docs.title: add-lib [args...]
docs.text:
Add one or more local libraries to the project.

flint add-lib [args...]

Arguments

Argument Description args... One or more local library paths/names to register

docs.title: add-flag [args...]
docs.text:
Add one or more compiler/build flags to the project configuration.

flint add-flag [args...]

Arguments

Argument Description args... One or more flags to add to the build configuration

docs.title: run
docs.text:
Build (if needed) and run the project.

flint run

docs.title: gen
docs.text:
Generate a compile_commands.json file for the project, for use with editor/IDE tooling and language servers.

flint gen

docs.title: sync
docs.text:
Sync project dependencies (e.g. fetch/update declared libraries).

flint sync

Note: Declare the chert composition in the dependencies section of your composition.json. Example chert composition:

"arena": {
    "version": "v0.1.1",
    "include_paths": [
        "include"
    ],
    "src": [
        "lib"
    ],
    "remote": "https://github.com/mainak55512/arena"
}

docs.title: Exit Codes
docs.text: Code Meaning 0 Command completed successfully 1 No command provided, or an unknown command was given

docs.title: Quick Reference
docs.text: Command Description init Initialize a new project add <url> Add a remote library dependency add-lib [args...] Add local library dependencies add-flag [args...] Add build flags build Build the project run Build and run the project gen Generate compile_commands.json sync Sync dependencies

docs.title: Flint Cherts
docs.text: Paste the "composition" for the dependency in the dependencies section of your composition.json file and run flint sync.

docs.title: Arena (lang: C)
docs.text:
An arena allocator written purely in C.

"arena": {
    "version": "v0.1.1",
    "include_paths": [
        "include"
    ],
    "src": [
        "lib"
    ],
    "remote": "https://github.com/mainak55512/arena"
}

docs.title: Crow (lang: C++)
docs.text:
A http server library for C++ projects.

"Crow": {
    "version": "1.1.1",
    "flags": [
        "-std=c++17",
        "-O3",
        "-DASIO_NO_DEPRECATED",
        "-DCROW_ENABLE_SSL",
        "-DCROW_ENABLE_COMPRESSION"
    ],
    "lib_links": [
        "-lpthread",
        "-lssl",
        "-lcrypto",
        "-lz"
    ],
    "include_paths": [
        "include"
    ],
    "src": [],
    "remote": "https://github.com/CrowCpp/Crow"
}

docs.title: Raylib (lang: C)
docs.text:
A graphics simulation library.

NOTE: the flags may change on the basis of environment. Below composition is for x11 systems.

"raylib": {
    "version": "unknown",
    "flags": [
        "-std=c99", "-D_GNU_SOURCE", "-DGL_SILENCE_DEPRECATION=199309L",
        "-DPLATFORM_DESKTOP_GLFW", "-DGRAPHICS_API_OPENGL_33",
        "-DSUPPORT_MODULE_RSHAPES=1", "-DSUPPORT_MODULE_RTEXTURES=1",
        "-DSUPPORT_MODULE_RTEXT=1", "-DSUPPORT_MODULE_RMODELS=1",
        "-DSUPPORT_MODULE_RAUDIO=1", "-D_GLFW_X11"
    ],
    "lib_links": [
        "-lGL", "-lX11", "-lXrandr", "-lXinerama", "-lXi",
        "-lXcursor", "-lm", "-lpthread", "-ldl", "-lrt"
    ],
    "include_paths": [
        "src",
        "src/platforms",
        "src/external/glfw/include"
    ],
    "src": [
        "src"
    ],
    "remote": "https://github.com/raysan5/raylib.git"
}
